dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that how the night shift works?

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: Well, I for one have never seen anywhere else where the night shift was busier than the day shift... Why do people around here wait until sundown to move all their goods?

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: It's not like they're transporting anything shifty! And even if they were, this isn't Fontaine — there are no Gardes about to stick their noses in others' affairs...

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: *sigh* I've been looking forward for ages to taking Cairuo to The Flagship for a drink... and now I'm stuck out here doing work!
